note: White River NF campground at ~8,800 ft in the Flat Tops, 46 mi east of Meeker: County Road 8 for 39 mi, then Trappers Lake Road (FR 205) south 6 mi. The Big Fish trailhead into the Flat Tops Wilderness is at the campground entrance; Rainbow and Big Fish lakes nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + 2026 White River operating-dates sheet: count 10->11, added max_rig_ft 36, season 06-03..10-19 (2026 estimated, weather dependent). Confirmed vault toilets, no potable water, FCFS, $25 (checked 2026). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Blanco Ranger District (970) 878-4039 (Meeker office, https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices); the campground page names the Blanco RD as its region but lists no number.
Website is the forest home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/himes-peak-campground.
Inclusion evidence relies on rvparking.com; the FS sheet's 11 sites / 36 ft max is the better source for the RV-fit call (36 ft clears EKKO's 23 ft).
Fees: the 2026 sheet says rates differ between weekdays and weekends but posts only $25; a weekend rate may be higher.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' holds: on imagery the loop sits on a bench ~90-120 m north of the North Fork White River's tree line.
Pin 40.0283,-107.2722 is ~30 m from the FS lat/long (40.028047,-107.272164); both on the campground loop. OK.
